topic.source_contract: TPOs, conservation-area notices, felling licences, forestry EIA, restocking and completion

scope_guards: A mapped TPO is not treated as exact tree identity without the order plan.
Planning permission is not treated as unrestricted consent for tree works.
A conservation-area notice is not treated as consent before the statutory process completes.
A felling-licence application is not treated as a granted licence.
A felling licence is not treated as forestry EIA consent where EIA applies.
A licence is not treated as compliance with protected-species duties.
Restocking conditions are not treated as discharged before establishment evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact tree binding, permission, conditions, completion and aftercare evidence.
